## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `058737c52124fe32075f37f9f16f4a327ba7a890`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md, skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json + packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts and packages/objectql/src/hook-wrappers.ts (the binding the text states; read at `bd4276a91`), the merged changeset `b25d98a46:.changeset/23910-validation-previous-insert.md` and `packages/objectql/CHANGELOG.md` L35–42 (the runtime truth), content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx L211 (the docs row), .changeset/23983-previous-null-on-insert.md (the PR's own changeset)

Read 2026-10-17T13:53Z in seat by `session_012PxNHU3dfov2hbpg9ycZ8q` (marchtian, `domain:skills#1`), whose served model is the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` value (`get_session` `last_served_model`). Inputs: card #23983 (body + 7 comments: 6220637775, 6221580524, 6234215977, 6234266379, 6234524569, 6234558372, 6234675212), PR #24174 (body, 4-file list, diff +47/−34 against base `bd4276a91`, two rounds: `d0c7d6f13` then the patch `058737c52`), the head's check-runs at this write, `origin/main` `bd4276a91`. Read-only: nothing built, run or re-run; the dev's local gate runs and ship-proof are its evidence, not repeated.

### ① Derived judgments

**The accept-set change: published skill text in three files of `skills/**` (shipped verbatim through `@objectstack/skills` `dist`), plus the owed changeset. No schema, no code.** Each sentence judged against the runtime truth — the merged changeset of PR #23971: 「On insert, `previous` is now bound to `null` in validation rules and in declarative hook conditions … `previous == null || …` judges an insert, `previous != null && …` skips one. A column read off `previous` on insert (`previous.stage`) still has no value and still refuses the write … A write to an existing row whose prior state is not in hand keeps `previous` unbound and still fails closed」 — and `formulas.mdx` L211 (「`null` on insert … a column read off it there (`previous.status`) has no value and faults | validation, hook conditions and flows — `null` on insert」):

- **`data-hooks.md`, the `previous` bullet (L247–256 at the head).** 「**`previous` is `null` on insert** … `previous == null || …` judges an insert and `previous != null && …` skips one; a column read off it there (`previous.done`) has no value and faults. `previous` is UNBOUND only for a write to an existing row whose prior state is not in hand, which fails closed rather than reading an update as an insert.」 — **right on all three facts**, in the changeset's own terms. The `before*`/`multi: true` sentence that followed is kept with its ADR-0058 Addendum II citation, re-anchored as 「**not** such a case」 (the unbound case) — right, the bulk dispatch binds `previous` per row.
- **`data-hooks.md`, the abort warning (L279–285).** The example 「a `previous` reference on an insert」 becomes 「a column read off `previous` on an insert」 — **right**: a bare `previous == null` on insert now evaluates, only the column read faults. The dropped sentence 「Those are opposite failures, so "the condition said no" and "the platform could not work out what the condition says" are now different outcomes and the second one is loud」 restated what the paragraph's 「it **fails the write**」 already says; explanatory, not a rule — **lossless for the rule set**, and it pays the tokens (10066 → 10059, ceiling unmoved).
- **`data-hooks.md`, the authoring consequence (L287–290).** 「on an insert event read `previous` only against `null` — a column read off it there is the mistake …」 — **right**, and it keeps the safety the old 「never on an insert event」 gave (the dispatch's 2(b): rewrite as the `null` guard, do not delete the safety).
- **`objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` §5 scope table (L306–307).** The insert row: 「**`null`** — `previous == null \|\| …` judges an insert, `previous != null && …` skips one; a column read off it (`previous.x`) has no value and faults」 — **right**; the new row 「A write to an existing row whose prior state is not in hand | **unbound** — fails closed, so `previous == null` never reads an update as an insert」 — **right**, the changeset's last sentence. Table pipes inside the code span are escaped (`\|\|`), so the row parses.
- **§5 abort note (L311–318) and the legacy-translation note (L376–380).** The first example becomes 「A column read off `previous` on an insert (`previous.status`, where `previous` is `null`)」 and the closing advice 「on an insert event read `previous` only against `null`, and put a column read off it behind `previous != null &&`」 — **right**. The `OLD.x` / `ISCHANGED(x)` note: 「has a value only where `previous` is a **row** … On an insert event `previous` is `null`, so the read … **fails the write** unless guarded by `previous != null &&`」 — **right**, and the card body named this note (「the note under the migration table restate it」), so it is in scope though the order enumerated only L306 and L312–314.
- **The eval fixture (round 2, `cel-predicates-formulas.json` case 3 `expected_output`).** 「On insert `previous` is `null`: the `previous.status` read faults and aborts the write, so to run on inserts guard with `previous != null &&`.」 — **right, and more exact than the seat's patch order**: that case's own condition reads `previous.status`, so on an insert it IS the faulting shape; the order's 「aborts nothing」 held for a bare `previous != null`, not for this condition, and the dev reported the falsification instead of writing the order's sentence. The tightened wording elsewhere in the same string (「Writes it once as」, 「the post-write state (true on every later update too)」, 「per row on `before*`/`after*` update events, bulk too」, 「No `ISCHANGED()` function」) keeps every assertion-relevant token (`previous.status`, `record.status`, `!=`; none of `ISCHANGED(`, `{previous.`) and every fact; the assertions block is untouched; the file is valid JSON (`json.load` at the head), 55 lines before and after (the round-2 comment's 「69/69」 is a transcription slip the dev corrected in its terminal copy; the seat's own `wc -l` reads 55), 4184 → 4181 bytes, tokens 1046/1046 (ceiling unmoved).
- **Token ratchet (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, the dev's run at both heads, not re-run here):** data-hooks.md 10066 → 10059 (ceiling 10066), formula SKILL.md 5399 → 5511 (ceiling 5997), the fixture 1046 → 1046 (ceiling 1046); no `CEILINGS` row moved; paid by deletion of restating text inside each file, not by re-wrap. Catalog: 13332 → 13336 lines across 65 files.
- **Other 「unbound」 hits in `skills/**`** (the dev's grep, re-read by the seat's `git grep -n unbound FETCH_HEAD -- skills`): the form-view `visibleWhen` client-side unbound root, 「unbounded」 queries/numbers, and `data-hooks.md`'s `ctx.previous` row (`undefined` on insert) — all still true; only the CEL binding changed. Right not to touch.
- **Main drift.** Base `bd4276a91` is `origin/main`'s tip at this write; `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main FETCH_HEAD` exits 0; the Version Packages PR's next re-stamp touches only the `version:` line of `skills/*/SKILL.md`.
- **Whole-package value density** (read from an agent that loads either skill): the old text sent authors around a fault that no longer happens and hid the `null` idiom the runtime now offers; the new text gives the idiom, the one remaining fault and the one remaining unbound case, in the same number of bullets. Right.

**Check-runs on `058737c52` at this write:** 31 `success`, 6 `skipped`, 1 `in_progress` (`Test Core (1/6)`); none failed. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset` are `success`. Convergence is read at landing, not here.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/23983-previous-null-on-insert.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no` with no arm, one summary line and one paragraph stating the binding and the `null` guard. `@objectstack/skills` is public (`publishConfig.access: public`; `files[]` = `dist`, built by `packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs` copying `skills/**` byte for byte), so the changeset is owed and `skip-changeset` does not apply — **right level, right clause**; the PR body's line 2 `Clause-②: no` matches the claim (6234215977) and the changeset.
- The changeset names the bullet, the scope-table row, the abort note and the legacy-translation note; it does not name the eval fixture sentence added in round 2. The fixture is the skill's own test data for the same statement, so the CHANGELOG entry stays true (nothing it says is false) and complete for an author; **accepted as is**, noted so the next changeset in this file's history reads it.
- No model identifier in the PR title, body (one session-URL footer), the two commits (model-free trailer pairs) or any comment read.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev reports 6234524569 (round 1) and 6234675212 (round 2): `open_questions: []` both rounds; round-1 deviations D1–D7 and round-2 deviations, each answered:

- **R1-D1** base `697301491` → `bd4276a91` at worktree creation; no conflict. **Answered.**
- **R1-D2** `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` NOT MEASURED locally (exit 3, whole-tree builds); CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs them — `success` on this head. **Answered.**
- **R1-D3** the `OLD.x` / `ISCHANGED(x)` note rewritten beyond the order's enumeration — the card body names it; inside the declared file. **Accepted.**
- **R1-D4** shallow checkout, no ancestry claim made. **n/a.**
- **R1-D5** model-free trailers kept against the harness reminder. **Right.**
- **R1-D6** no label write (a changeset is owed). **Right.**
- **R1-D7** the round-1 report comment carries a literal angle-bracket email in a trailer quotation; read back byte-identical; not re-edited (a fifth write). **Accepted**; the `os-dev-report` marker and JSON are intact.
- **R1 OOS-1** the eval fixture sentence — **absorbed by the patch round** (claim amendment 6234558372) under the in-place fix's four conditions; no sub-issue.
- **R2** worktree recreated from the branch at `d0c7d6f13` (Resume-from), nothing merged from `main`; the order's wording falsified for this fixture's own condition and the truth written instead (**right**, see ①); the round-2 comment's fixture line count 「69/69」 is wrong, 55/55 is right (seat-measured) — a record slip, not a diff defect; PR body not patched by the dev (⛔ per the order) — **the seat patches the body's Acceptance notes in this act** so the body no longer calls the fixture 「not changed here」.

Reviewer's own flags: none. `mcp_calls` 0 both rounds; `api_writes` three relay strokes in all (`pr_create` with the assignee, two report comments) plus three `git push`; no label write, no PATCH, no MCP write.

Reviewed-by: `session_012PxNHU3dfov2hbpg9ycZ8q`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

**改了什么**:两个对外发布技能(`objectstack-data`、`objectstack-formula`)里说「`previous` 在 insert 上 unbound、insert 条件只能写 `record`」的四处文字,加 formula 技能 eval fixture 里同一句,改成运行时现状:insert 上 `previous` 为 `null`,`previous == null || …` 判 insert、`previous != null && …` 跳过 insert;只有读它的列(`previous.status`)才报错;只有「已存在行但旧值不在手」才 unbound 且失败关闭。附一个 `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset。token:data-hooks.md 10066→10059(顶 10066),formula SKILL.md 5399→5511(顶 5997),fixture 1046/1046;上限都没动。

**为什么改**:PR #23971(#23910,10-16 合并)把 insert 上的 `previous` 绑成 `null`,原技能文本随即为假;照旧文写元数据的 AI 会绕一个已不存在的故障,也用不上新的 `null` 写法。文档站 `formulas.mdx` 已先一步改了。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯文本 + changeset,不改任何键或行为;`ctx.previous`(hook 代码里的 `undefined`)那行有意不动,因为只有 CEL 绑定变了。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的两个 commit。

**席位意见**:ACCEPT。逐句对照 #23971 的 changeset 与 `formulas.mdx` L211 核过(见上方 `## Contract review` PASS);dev 第 2 轮还纠正了席位补丁令里一处不准确的措辞(fixture 那条自身读列,insert 上会报错而非「无事」),写的是实测真相。

**你要做的**:对 PR #24174 给一个 APPROVED review(`skills/**` 是 Tier H)。批准后由席位落地(入队、合并),不需要其他动作。CI 在头 `058737c52` 上 31 绿 6 预期跳过,余 1 个分片收敛中,落地前席位再读一次。

## 席位核对

Seat `domain:skills#1` · `session_012PxNHU3dfov2hbpg9ycZ8q` (marchtian) · read 2026-10-17T14:01Z · head `058737c52124fe32075f37f9f16f4a327ba7a890` · **verdict: ACCEPT** (Tier H — stays draft for an authorized approval; the seat lands after it)

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-23983-previous-null-on-insert`
Reviewed-by: `session_012PxNHU3dfov2hbpg9ycZ8q`

1. **Shape.** Draft PR against `main`; body line 1 `Fixes #23983`, line 2 `Clause-②: no` (from claim 6234215977). The only closing keyword is the `Fixes` line; no other open card number sits beside a closing verb. Files: `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` (+22/−21), `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` (+15/−12), `skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json` (+1/−1, round 2 under claim amendment 6234558372), `.changeset/23983-previous-null-on-insert.md` (new). Base `bd4276a91` = `origin/main` tip; `merge-tree` exit 0. The seat patched the body's Acceptance notes in this act (the fixture bullet now records the round-2 fix).
2. **Premise and acceptance, read by the seat.** Every rewritten sentence matches PR #23971's changeset and `formulas.mdx` L211 (contract review 6234710626 ①). The `record`-alone advice is kept as the `null` guard, not deleted. Token ceilings unmoved, paid by deletion inside each file; catalog 13332 → 13336 lines across 65 files (the two `skills/**` readings are in the PR body).
3. **Gates — check-runs pinned to head `058737c52`** at this read: 31 `success` (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, every `Lint ·` / `Type Check ·` lane, `Test Core` 3–6/6, the three claim checks, `Dogfood Regression Gate`), 6 `skipped`, 1 `in_progress` (`Test Core (1/6)`), 0 failed; `check-expected-skips.mjs --pr 24174` exits 3 while that shard runs (a reading of no reading) — re-read at landing. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 24174`: GOVERNED, **Tier H** (`skills/**` ×3), +47/−34 under the threshold.
4. **Changeset.** `@objectstack/skills` patch, `Clause-②: no`, read sentence by sentence against the diff (contract review ②); `Check Changeset` `success`. No `skip-changeset` (rightly).
5. **Report hygiene.** `mcp_calls` 0 both rounds; `api_writes` three relay strokes + three pushes; no PATCH by the dev; deviations answered in the contract review; the round-2 report's fixture line count 「69/69」 is a slip (55/55 measured by the seat).
6. **Out of scope.** Round 1's finding was absorbed as the round-2 fix; the other `unbound` hits in `skills/**` are true and untouched; nothing filed.
7. **Landing (Tier H).** In this act: `needs-user-decision` on the PR, review requested from `os-zhuang` and `hotlong`. Landing needs an authorized APPROVED review (the contract review PASS is on this head). Then the two pre-landing checks and the relay `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`. `subscribe_pr_activity` live on this PR.
